title: TF-MAPS: fast high-resolution functional and allosteric mapping of DNA-binding proteins
one_liner_zh: 该文提出TF-MAPS平台，通过深度突变扫描绘制转录因子HNF1A、FOXG1和FOXP1的功能与别构图谱，揭示DNA结合界面与蛋白表面的别构耦合，虽以实验为主但聚焦TF-DNA互作且对结合位点与别构调控机制有建模启发，方法可迁移至AI/物理模拟研究。
abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) bind specific DNA sequences to control gene expression. Modulating TF activity is of considerable therapeutic interest but very few TFs have been successfully drugged. TF DNA-binding interfaces are large and most TFs have no known allosteric ligands or allosteric sites. Here, we introduce TF-MAPs, a scalable and general platform to chart complete functional maps of sequence-specific DNA-binding proteins. We apply TF-MAPS to three human disease TFs: HNF1A, FOXG1 and FOXP1. Allostery in all three proteins is distance-dependent, anisotropic, and couples the DNA-binding interface to the protein surface. The allosteric surfaces of FOXG1 and FOXP1 are quite diverged, revealing a potential for protein-specific regulation in protein families. All three TFs have potentially druggable pockets where mutations have strong functional effects on binding, either within the binding interface or distant from it. Using TF-MAPS it should be possible to chart functional and allosteric maps for hundreds of human TFs and other DNA-binding proteins to understand DNA recognition and TF regulation, to mechanistically interpret clinical variants, and to guide the development of TF-modulating therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）结合特定DNA序列以控制基因表达。调节转录因子活性具有相当大的治疗意义，但很少有转录因子被成功靶向药物化。转录因子的DNA结合界面庞大，且大多数转录因子没有已知的变构配体或变构位点。在此，我们介绍了TF-MAPs，一个可扩展且通用的平台，用于绘制序列特异性DNA结合蛋白的完整功能图谱。我们将TF-MAPS应用于三种人类疾病相关转录因子：HNF1A、FOXG1和FOXP1。这三种蛋白质中的变构效应均具有距离依赖性、各向异性，并将DNA结合界面与蛋白质表面耦合。FOXG1和FOXP1的变构表面差异显著，揭示了蛋白质家族中可能存在蛋白质特异性调控。所有三种转录因子均具有潜在可药物化的口袋，其中突变对结合产生强烈功能影响，无论是位于结合界面内还是远离界面处。利用TF-MAPS，应能绘制数百种人类转录因子及其他DNA结合蛋白的功能和变构图谱，以理解DNA识别与转录因子调控，机械性地解读临床变异，并指导转录因子调节治疗药物的开发。
